A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the
work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety
glasses.
Isolate the transformer out of service and earthed from both sides.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes and safety clothes.
Check periodically the service ability of all the insulators.

Check the resistor grids after each grounding fault if it is not possible, 
 check the grounding resistor.

Clean the metallic filters and the ventilation slits blowing out with 
 compressed air.

In case of trouble of resistor grids, replace the burned grid and control the 
 total Ohmic value of the resistor.

In case of trouble of the insulator, change the broken insulators and test the 
 dielectric resistively.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, 
to be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title 
block.
This first draft is initiated by eng. Samy Mohamed Hassan, tested by tested by 
Hassan Ahmed Mohamed Rostm, at 18 Jan 2004, revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control eng. Tawfeq El-abasey, accepted 
by general manager eng. Mohamed Abd El Ghaffar, and certified by eng. Moustafa 
Al Lethy; EDEPCo. Inspection & QC head sector.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the
work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety
glasses.
Isolate the transformer out of service and earthed from both sides.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes and safety clothes.
Tools and
Equipment
Safety 
 helmet, shoes,
Blower compressed air.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
Screw drivers set.
Dielectric resistively tests equipment.
Ohmic value control set.
New semblance insulators.
Check periodically the service ability of all the insulators.
Check the resistor grids after each grounding fault if it is not possible, 
 check the grounding resistor.
Clean the metallic filters and the ventilation slits blowing out with 
 compressed air.
No lubrication
In case of trouble of resistor grids, replace the burned grid and control the 
 total Ohmic value of the resistor.
In case of trouble of the insulator, change the broken insulators and test the 
 dielectric resistively.
